outcome: fetal complications (prematurity, low birth weight, congenital anomalies)
cohort: 200 Egyptian women with rheumatoid arthritis and 100 healthy age-matched controls
finding: Pregnant women with RA had a higher frequency of abortion, Cesarean section delivery, preeclampsia, and low birth weight newborns, especially those with higher disease activity and/or treated with potentially harmful medications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was higher in women with RA.
